To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Pl-free edge-modification problems do not admit polynomial kernels unless NP⊆co-NP/poly; (2) the cograph edge-modifcation problems have cubic kernels; (3) the cograph completion problem is FPT and admits a kernel of size O(k2) but not of size O(k).

the edge-deletion and edge-editing problems are unlikely to admit polynomial kernels when the forbidden induced subgraphs are paths of length l≥7 and l⩾4 respectively, whereas the edge-completion and edge-deletion problems admit cubic vertex kernels for the class of P4-free (i.e. C4-free) graphs.

the edge-deletion problem for the Pl-free property does not admit a polynomial kernel unless NP⊆co-NP/poly, and the edge-deletion and edge-editing problems for the Cl-free property do not admit a polynomial kernels unless NP⊆ co-NP/poly.
